deities: Shiva (as Nimbeshwar/Nimbo Ka Nath Mahadev); a Navdurga shrine established by the Pandavas is also worshipped

history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: Nimbo Ka Nath is NOT in Pali city - it stands on the road between Falna and Sanderao in Pali district. Documented with the corrected location; coordinates are an approximate midpoint of the Falna-Sanderao road - verify on site. Legend holds that Kunti, mother of the Pandavas, worshipped Shiva here during exile, and the Pandavas established a Navdurga shrine. A center of faith for Pali's people with carved walls and a handcrafted Shiva idol; fairs on Shivratri and Baisakhi Purnima draw thousands. No construction date or patron is documented in the sources found.

name: Nimbo Ka Nath Temple
town: Between Falna and Sanderao, Pali district (CSV town 'Pali' is imprecise - the temple is not in Pali city)
town_description: Sanderao (also spelled Sanderav) is a small town on the Falna route in Pali district, and Falna is a railway junction town at the Aravalli foothills south of Pali city. The Nimbo Ka Nath temple lies in the rural stretch between them - scrubland and small farms off the main road - reached by taxi/jeep from Falna.

travel.railway: Falna railway station - about 10-15 km; hire a taxi/jeep to the temple.
travel.road: On the Falna-Sanderao road in Pali district; buses run to Falna, then local transport.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Shivratri and Baisakhi Purnima for the fairs.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open all days; no entry fee (verify - confirm locally).
